name: codrian-o-cliente-foi-roubado
description: Vídeo publicitário 45s vertical (CODRIAN) em Frame Motion 2D com GSAP

scripts.draft: npm run cues && npm run mix && node scripts/render.mjs --draft && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video-draft-mudo.mp4 -i out/audio-mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 160k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/CODRIAN_o-cliente-foi-roubado_DRAFT.mp4
scripts.final: npm run cues && npm run mix && node scripts/render.mjs --final && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video-final.mp4 -i out/audio-mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/CODRIAN_o-cliente-foi-roubado_FINAL.mp4
